documents.title: AutomationControllerHousekeeping
documents.summary: Housekeeping Preventive maintenance plays an important role in minimizing downtime. The “House Keeping” or HouseKeep table is used to do periodic cleanup of database tables. It is used to purge data no longer needed from the database. These routines are typically established by Fortna personnel. The HouseKeep table is used to configure the actions to be taken and to set the schedule. Since time is often a consideration in deciding what to purge, database tables usually include a timestamp field. Actions are entered in a format based on Structured Query Language (SQL). documents.title: FPC-PNA-ZebraPrintEngineAutomaticDisconnect
documents.summary: Zebra Print Engine Automatic Disconnection The Zebra Print Engine has a feature to automatically disconnect a TCP/IP connection after 5 minutes. To disable this feature use a web browser to connect to the printer’s ip address. Click View and Modify Printer Settings. If you get a login screen, Zebra’s default password is 1234. Click Network Configuration. Click TCP/IP Settings. Set Timeout Checking to NO. Click Submit Changes. Click “Save Current Configuration” from the “View and Modify Printer Settings” page to make the change permanent!
